description: Read social timeline posts (optionally with matching comments attached via includeComments: true), fetch comments (filterable by platform, integrationId, postId, or unreplied only), fetch member reactions on a post, or reply to a comment across connected social channels.

includeComments.description: Attach matching comments to each post returned by get_timeline

integrationId.description: Optional integration ID to filter get_timeline/get_comments, or required for get_reactions and reply

isTopLevel.description: Optional flag for top-level post comments vs threaded replies

pageId.description: Optional actor pageId when replying as a LinkedIn Company Page vs Personal Profile

postId.description: Optional post ID to filter get_comments, or required for get_reactions

refresh.description: Bypass short-lived cache when fetching timeline or comments

unreplied.description: Filter get_comments (or get_timeline with includeComments) to unreplied comments only

name: wordflux_manage_social_inbox
